nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $b$, $n$ and $m$, the units-place carry of $n + m$ in base $b$ (taken to be $0$ when $b \le 1$) equals $\lfloor ((n \bmod b) + (m \bmod b)) / b \rfloor$, where $n \bmod 0 = n$ and division by $0$ gives $0$.
nodes.title: Units-place carry as a quotient

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $b$, $n$ and $m$, the units-place carry $\varepsilon_0^{b,n,m}$ of $n + m$ in base $b$ is $1$ if $b > 1$ and $(n \bmod b) + (m \bmod b) \ge b$, and $0$ otherwise; in particular it is $0$ for the invalid bases $b \le 1$.
